messages:
Maria Gomez: FYI I've opened PR #8591 to tighten secrets scoping for the on-prem control plane. Adds a dedicated KMS key alias + restricted service account bindings. CI is green. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8591
Sanjay Patel: quick question 1: does this introduce any new long-lived credentials or SAs? or just KMS-wrapped secrets like before? :thinking_face:
Maria Gomez: just KMS-wrapped secrets. No plaintext creds. Adds alias `alias/redwood/onprem-cp` and limits Decrypt to the onprem-control-plane SA.
Ellie Chen: thanks. security checklist: (1) include key rotation/migration steps in the PR, (2) ensure key audit logs are enabled and referenced, (3) confirm no new open egress to public S3. Can you add those?
Maria Gomez: will add migration instructions + rollback steps. We're using the existing S3 VPC endpoint, config flag `USE_S3_VPC=true` included in the change.
ci-bot: CI passed 705f
Kevin O'Leary: infra side ok, one operational ask: pick a low-traffic merge window (02:00-04:00 UTC preferred) and attach a 1-page smoke test for oncall. Also add a `kubectl` rollback snippet.
Maria Gomez: setting merge window to 02:45 UTC. Added smoke test doc and rollback commands. Snippet: 
```
# smoke test (basic)
curl -sS https://onprem-control.example/health | jq .status
kubectl logs -n redwood-onprem deployment/onprem-control --tail=50
```
Rollback example: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/onprem-control --namespace=redwood-onprem
```
Ellie Chen: one more: please confirm key-level audit logging. If it's enabled in prod but not staging, note that in the PR and add the audit-policy link.
Maria Gomez: confirmed. Audit logs are enabled in both prod and staging now; added the cloud KMS IAM/policy link and the audit-policy snippet in the PR description.
Sanjay Patel: ran local secret-scan, no hits. thanks for adding the migration plan.
Ellie Chen: tiny nit: log message in control-plane controller uses `debug` level for a sensitive path; change to `info` and redact token-like strings. Not blocking. Once updated I'll approve.
Maria Gomez: fixed the log level and redaction, pushed a small commit, updated PR. Tagging @Ellie Chen and @Kevin O'Leary for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
Kevin O'Leary: approve from infra. Please post a 15-min heads-up to #oncall before merging and include the smoke test checklist.
Maria Gomez: will post the heads-up. Planning merge at 02:45 UTC tonight unless anyone objects. Thanks all! :pray:
ci-bot: pipeline: unit + int-stage passed (all checks green)
Ellie Chen: approved (non-blocking nit addressed) :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: merging at 02:45 UTC. sending notice to #oncall now.
